notes.title: Update 12th of June
notes.content:
[h1]Update Highlights:[/h1]

[list]
[*][h2]Gunplay Mechanics Enhanc'd:[/h2]

Substantial improvements have been wrought upon the gunplay, assuring more accurate hit detection. Players shall now receive precise feedback when their bullets strike true.

[*][h2]Introduction of the Gambling Tent:[/h2]

The initial version of the gambling tent hath been added. Though it presently offers but a modest selection of prizes, more exciting rewards shall be forthcoming in future updates.

[*][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

Addressed numerous major and minor bugs as per player feedback, thereby enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

[/list]
We express our deepest gratitude for thy continued support and invaluable feedback! Look forward to more updates anon.
